one_line: Tell a long-awaited project, build it in quick steps, end on the child's joy, offer links for one word.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close-up of a white box corner with the label "FLISAT" and an IKEA logo; at 0:02 hands cut the box open. Voiceover (transcript) and subtitles: "את הפרויקט הזה אני מתכננת כבר ממש הרבה זמן", "אבל בכוונה חיכיתי איתו".
q1_hook.why: "A project I planned for a long time, and waited on on purpose" opens a question that the child's joy at 0:52 closes (H5). The branded box is on screen at 0:00 and opened by 0:02 (S1, H3), with voice and subtitles together (H6, H4). The value is unstated, a teaser (H2).

beats.what: FLISAT box label, then hands cut the box open; "את הפרויקט הזה אני מתכננת כבר ממש הרבה זמן"
beats.why: A named product and a waiting story

beats.what: A screen recording of upgraded dollhouses; "ידעתי שיום אחד אני רוצה"
beats.why: The idea of upgrading, shown in 2 s

beats.what: Fast jump cuts: frame screwed together, wallpaper smoothed, a stapler; "הכי בסיסי של איקאה"
Hot glue and wooden bead trim along the roof and floors; "הוספתי מסביב לייסטים דקורטיביים קטנים"
beats.why: The upgrade that makes it look different

beats.what: Finished frame on a shelf; furniture and dolls placed one by one in one 21 s shot
beats.why: The house fills up as the story is told

beats.what: Kitchen unit close-up; the house at an angle; "תכתבו לי "בית" בתגובות"
beats.why: The ask over the finished house

beats.what: A girl about 4 to 5 shouts with joy; two children play at the house; subtitled lines
beats.why: The emotional payoff, in the last 7 s

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen 0:48-0:51 and in the caption: comment "בית" to get the item links. The caption asks "רוצות את כל הלינקים לפריטים שהשתמשתי בהם?". The delivered links are the reason to comment.
q2_flow.why: A waited-for project, a build, a house filling up and a child's joy make a clear story with the payoff at the end (K2, R4), with new visuals every 2 to 3 s early (R3). The 21 s furnishing shot has little change but is carried by the voice (R1). The comment word delivers real links (R6).

q3_cta.what: Spoken and subtitled 0:48-0:51: "תכתבו לי "בית" בתגובות / ואשלח לכן את הלינקים לכל הפריטים שהשתמשתי בהם". Caption: "רוצות את כל הלינקים לפריטים שהשתמשתי בהם? כתבו ״בית״ בתגובות ואשלח לכן הכל לפרטי", and an update on a fault.
q3_cta.why: One action with a named benefit, said, shown and repeated in the caption (C1, C3, C6), placed after the house is revealed. The keyword is generic, and the delivered links are the reason to comment (R6). The caption's first line is a fault notice, not the ask (C6).

q4_shown.what: The IKEA box label 0:00; a Pinterest screen recording 0:05; hands assembling, wallpapering and gluing bead trim 0:09-0:25; miniature furniture and dolls placed in a finished house 0:26-0:47; two children at the house 0:52-0:58. No price.
q4_shown.why: The product is handled from 0:02 (S1), and a mother's first-person story with a visible transformation is checkable proof (S6, K5). The children's faces with a subtitle naming them are what LumeBook Reels avoid (S5). No price, and no disclosure words for the links (S3, S7).

q5_edit.what: 24 shots in 59 s, about 2.5 s each; 11 hard cuts in 0:05-0:17, one locked-off shot of 21 s from 0:26 to 0:47, with jump cuts inside. Voiceover almost wall to wall, subtitles in 2 lines synced to it. Ends on children playing.
q5_edit.why: Quick jump cuts through the building remove dead air (E2). Synced subtitles carry the story muted (E4). The one long locked-off shot is slow but sustained by new objects arriving (R3). It ends right after the payoff (E8). At 59 s it is long for one craft (R2).

q6_topic.what: A mother upgrades the basic IKEA dollhouse with wallpaper, bead trim and miniatures, and her children play in it. Serves parents who want a DIY gift or room project.
q6_topic.why: A visible before and after wrapped in a personal waiting story and her children's joy (K4, K1, K2). A DIY project with a named item list is something to send to another parent (R5), though no occasion is named (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Close-up of the box label; a propped medium shot of the table; top-down handheld hands on a carpet; a static eye-level wide of the shelf for 21 s; a handheld selfie-style shot of the girl and her brother.
q7_filmed.why: A home, daylight and a propped phone look native (H8, F7). Top-down hands show each step from the maker's view (F5), and the finished house fills the frame (F4). The subtitles sit low over the build (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Cream-yellow subtitles with a thin outline, centred about 75% down, one or two lines, synced to the voice: "את הפרויקט הזה אני מתכננת כבר ממש הרבה זמן" (0:00), "אז לקחתי את בית הבובות הכי בסיסי של איקאה" (0:15), "תכתבו לי "בית" בתגובות" (0:48), and the children's lines in quotes (0:52). No headline card. A Pinterest title at 0:05.
q8_text.caption: "** עדכון ** יש כרגע תקלה באוטומציה וחלק מכן לא מקבלות את הלינק בפרטי". About 65 words: a fault update first, a story line, the ask for links, 5 hashtags (#איקאה #ביתבובות). The children are named. No disclosure words.
q8_text.why: Subtitling every line lets a muted viewer follow (T1), but near-verbatim and at the low part of the frame (T2, T4). The cream-yellow text is held about 2 s a card, readable (T5). The caption has product keywords and 5 hashtags, but its first line is a fault notice, not the hook (T7).

weak_points: A fault notice as the first caption line; the children named in the caption and a subtitle; early jump cuts blur the steps; a 21 s single shot; no price or disclosure words; an IKEA product, not brand-owned.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a long-awaited-moment line over the opened parcel, show the book in quick top-down cuts, then the one-word offer and, if a child appears, only a no-face shot.
not_verified: Whether the links are affiliate or gifted (no label). The exact steps at 0:09-0:17, blurred by the jump cuts. The brand of the miniatures. Music is not evident. Whether the 0:05 screen recording shows another account's posts. Correction to src/coded: the girl's face is visible at 0:52-0:58, and she is about 4 to 5. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
